items.prompt:
Sustainability means using resources
A) without using them up or harming the environment
B) as fast as possible
C) only once
D) never
items.answer: A) without using them up or harming the environment

items.prompt:
A growing human population uses
A) more resources
B) fewer resources
C) no resources
D) only air

Which is a way to manage resources sustainably?
A) Conserving water
B) Wasting water
C) Clearing all forests
D) Overfishing

Overusing resources can
A) reduce biodiversity
B) increase biodiversity
C) create new planets
D) have no effect

Using water faster than it is replaced is
A) not sustainable
B) sustainable
C) always fine
D) impossible

Protecting habitats helps
A) biodiversity
B) pollution
C) resource depletion
D) nothing

Resource management, population, and biodiversity are connected because
A) a growing population strains resources and biodiversity, but wise management reduces the strain
B) they are unrelated
C) population has no effect
D) resources are unlimited
items.answer: A) a growing population strains resources and biodiversity, but wise management reduces the strain

items.prompt:
Besides today's needs, sustainability considers
A) future generations' needs
B) only the past
C) only one person
D) no one
